verdict.rationale: Bruno ships first-party Bruno AI that accepts natural-language instructions. Users can describe what they need to generate pre-request/post-response scripts, tests and endpoint docs, ask questions in an AI Chat Sidebar from anywhere in the workspace, and generate complete custom Apps from context. It uses BYOK, OpenAI-compatible providers, including local models. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands can drive core operations directly (running requests or collections, managing environments, creating collections in-app), and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well these AI features work.
